theme.title: NBA Mix 25
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: In 2023 Nikola Jokić became the lowest draft pick ever to win Finals MVP. Where was he picked in 2014?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the lowest-selected player to ever win Finals MVP, being the 41st pick of the 2014 NBA draft

funFacts.text: Denver's championship was its first in nearly half a century as an NBA franchise.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first championship in franchise history after 47 seasons in the NBA

funFacts.text: The Nuggets became just the second club from the old ABA to win an NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They became the second former American Basketball Association (ABA) team to win an NBA title

funFacts.text: Denver reached its first NBA Finals by sweeping the Lakers in the West finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets defeated the Lakers in four games, marking their first sweep of an opponent

questions.prompt: How much prize money did each player on the 2023 In-Season Tournament champions earn?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Players on the tournament championship team: $500,000 each

funFacts.text: Players on runner-up Indiana still collected $200,000 each for their tournament run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Players on the tournament runner-up team: $200,000 each

funFacts.text: Losing semifinalists received $100,000 each, even without reaching the title game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Players on teams that lose in the semifinals: $100,000 each

funFacts.text: Unlike earlier knockout games, the Cup championship did not count toward the NBA regular-season standings.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Quarterfinal and semifinal games counted as regular season games, affecting teams' positions in league standings, but the championship game did not.

questions.prompt: Boston made a playoff-record nine threes in one fourth quarter against Philadelphia in 2002. How many did it make in the whole game?
questions.note: 19, nine of them in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hitting an NBA playoff record nine of them in the 4th quarter and 19 in the game

funFacts.text: Boston's barrage came in a winner-take-all first-round game against Allen Iverson's Philadelphia 76ers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This set the stage for a Game 5 in Boston to decide the series

funFacts.text: The Celtics' perimeter onslaught ended the Sixers' season and set up a series against Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston won in a huge blowout, sending them to the conference semifinals to face second-seed Detroit

funFacts.text: The hot shooting was concentrated in the fourth quarter, when Boston's perimeter attack caught fire.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hitting an NBA playoff record nine of them in the 4th quarter

questions.prompt: In Game 7 of the 2018 West finals, Houston set a playoff record by missing how many threes in a row?
questions.context: 2018 Western Conference finals · Game 7 · vs Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set an NBA Playoff record by missing 27 straight 3-point shots

funFacts.text: Houston lost Chris Paul to a right hamstring injury late in Game 5; he missed the rest of the Warriors series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chris Paul suffered a "right hamstring injury" in the final minute. He did not play for the rest of the series

funFacts.text: The eventual champion Warriors were pushed to a deciding conference-finals Game 7 by Houston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They lost the conference finals to the eventual NBA champion Golden State Warriors in seven games

funFacts.text: Golden State's win set up a fourth straight NBA Finals meeting with LeBron James's Cavaliers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first time the same two NBA teams met in the NBA Finals four seasons in a row

questions.prompt: How many points did Steve Nash score in the 2005 playoff clincher against Dallas?
questions.context: Phoenix at Dallas · conference semifinals · Game 6
questions.note: 39 points in Phoenix's overtime series-clinching win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 6 May 20 @ Dallas W 130–126 (OT) Steve Nash (39)

funFacts.text: Phoenix eliminated Nash's former Dallas team in six games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated Nash's former team, the Dallas Mavericks, in six games

funFacts.text: The clincher ended in a 130–126 overtime win for Phoenix.
Shawn Marion grabbed 16 rebounds during that same decisive game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Nash (39) Shawn Marion (16) Steve Nash (12)
